Title: Find the Inside Valve for Your Outdoor Faucet
Description: A standard outdoor faucet needs its inside valve closed and the line drained. A frost-free one mostly needs the hose off. How to tell which you have and find the valve.

Title: Why Long Grass Over Winter Invites Snow Mold
Description: Cool-season lawns: mow at normal height until growth stops, then drop one notch at most. Warm-season lawns stay in range. Last-cut height table by setting.
Keywords: lawn care, fall and winter yard

Title: Why Reheating Won't Rescue Food Left Out Too Long
Description: Party food can sit out 2 hours, or 1 hour above 90°F, and the clock runs before guests arrive. Why reheating won't save it, plus a platter-swap schedule.
Keywords: food safety, food storage and leftovers

Title: How Much Water to Knead Into Hard Brown Sugar
Description: Hard brown sugar has dried out and is still usable. Which fixes re-harden as they cool, which restore moisture, and how much water to knead in per cup or bag.

Title: Pack summer clothes in the right bin, not a plastic bag
Description: Wash even clean-looking clothes, skip starch and softener, and pack them fully dry. A table rates dry-cleaning bags, bins, cardboard, cedar chests and suitcases.
